For companies buying in Poland

Money spent with us counts on your side.

A Polish company with Polish capital, a Polish team and delivery in Poland. We meet all six domestic entity criteria of the Local Content Code of Good Practice — which means money spent with us counts towards your own local content indicator instead of leaving the Polish economy.

The criteria

Local content is not a claim. It is six criteria.

The Polish Ministry of State Assets defined what a “domestic entity” is and assigned weights to it. There is no room for interpretation — a criterion is either met or it is not. Everything below can be verified in the national court register.

Domestic entity criteria — ministry weights

  • Ultimate beneficial owner based in Poland25%
  • Core business activity carried out in Poland25%
  • Tax residency in Poland15%
  • Over half of staff taxed and insured in Poland15%
  • Registered in Poland, trading for over 3 years10%
  • Over half of annual turnover generated in Poland10%
100%Vis Technologie meets all six criteria.

For the board it is a line in the report

State-owned companies operate under a Local Content Code of Good Practice, with board-level KPIs, designated officers and periodic reporting written into contracts. The national statistics office measures domestic origin — the first such office in the EU. Choosing a domestic supplier is not a gesture; it fills your own indicator.

This is not protectionism

Local content works through non-price award criteria, not through a ban on buying abroad. It remains compliant with EU public procurement law and with the “Buy European” programme.

A short supply chain

We design, integrate and maintain in Poland. Support runs in Polish and English, and service is measured in hours of driving — not weeks of waiting for a shipment from abroad.

What you get from a domestic supplier

Local content opens the door. There has to be a product behind it.

We do not build an advantage on origin alone. Being domestic tips the scale between comparable offers — it does not replace the product. So here is what we actually do.

Systems built to measure

For over ten years we have built the systems that industrial, logistics and energy companies run on every day. One of them has been in production at an intermodal terminal operator for twelve years.

AI on edge devices

Neural networks computed on site rather than in the cloud — where data cannot leave the plant, or where the connection is narrow and unreliable.

Acoustic machine monitoring

An AI probe listens to the machinery house and catches a change in sound before the machine stops. Proven on wind turbines, rolling out on terminal cranes. See how it works →
